name: Web Wonderland SEO Image Optimiser
author: webwonderland

sections.description:
Improve image delivery with optional AI-assisted alt text and attachment titles.

  • Generate WebP/AVIF locally when supported by your server, with original-file backups.
  • Deliver modern formats through picture markup or server rewriting, using a derivative manifest.
  • Configure quality, delivery and queued upload automation with guided setup.
  • Generate optional SmartAlt suggestions in your site language, including background library processing.
  • Review or explicitly authorise auto-application, with before/after history and undo.

This is an independent plugin developed by Web Wonderland. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by WordPress, Elementor or WPBakery.

Local and cloud processing

Local optimisation uses your server’s CPU, disk and image libraries, without an API key or monthly conversion allowance.

Remote conversion and SmartAlt require a Cloud API key. Lite, Pro and Unlimited allowances differ; see Cloud Services for account limits and https://store.webwonderland.co.uk for plans.

Choose Local or Remote API in settings. Generated files remain on your server if a cloud allowance is exhausted or a key expires; local optimisation remains available.

Background SmartAlt

Open SEO Image Optimiser > Smart Alt & Titles (Cloud), then use Background SmartAlt:

  1. Choose missing alt text only (recommended), or all supported images.
  2. Choose review-only or auto-apply, optional title updates, a minimum AI score and an image limit (0 = all eligible images present at start).
  3. For automatic application, accept the AI accuracy acknowledgement and confirm the run. Replacing existing alt text requires a separate acknowledgement.
  4. Return to check progress, pause, resume or cancel. Cancellation retains completed changes.

JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF images are supported, including publicly accessible offloaded/CDN copies. Runs use your SmartAlt allowance and pause at its limit. Later uploads are handled separately.

AI descriptions can be inaccurate. Scores are self-reported, not accuracy guarantees. In background runs, below-threshold, missing-score and decorative results stay in review. A threshold of 0 permits auto-application of every scored non-decorative caption. Check important names, product details and text.

Work continues after the browser closes using WordPress cron and remote heartbeat support; timing depends on hosting and scheduler availability.

Before/after history and undo

Administrators can compare saved alt text and titles across background, upload-automation and manual SmartAlt changes.

Use Undo change for one entry, or select a run and choose Undo this run for background restoration. Finish or cancel captioning before starting undo.

Undo restores only changed fields that still match the recorded after values, protecting newer edits. Suggestions remain available; undo does not refund generation allowance.

History starts with 1.1.3; earlier changes are not reconstructed. Original image-file restoration is separate from metadata undo.

AI & Privacy

AI captioning is optional. Selected images and associated context are sent to Web Wonderland Cloud and its AI provider as described below. Images and context may contain personal information; only submit material you are authorised to share.

Your WordPress database stores before/after alt text and titles, attachment IDs, source, user IDs, timestamps and restore outcomes. Run settings and auto-apply acknowledgements (user/time) are also stored locally. History does not expire automatically. Undo makes no new caption request.

External services

Web Wonderland Image Optimisation API

Domain: imageapi.webwonderland.co.uk
Purpose: optional remote WebP/AVIF conversion, job status and download manifests.

Endpoints:
* https://imageapi.webwonderland.co.uk/v1/jobs
* https://imageapi.webwonderland.co.uk/v1/jobs/{job_id}
* https://imageapi.webwonderland.co.uk/v1/jobs/{job_id}/complete

Data sent: API key in request headers; attachment IDs; public or short-lived secure image URLs; requested sizes, formats and quality; plugin/schema version and site identifiers where needed.

When sent: when remote processing runs, including upload automation and background jobs. Status is polled while a job runs; completion is signalled after processed files are stored.

Terms: https://www.webwonderland.co.uk/wwsio-terms/
Privacy: https://www.webwonderland.co.uk/wwsio-privacy-policy/

Web Wonderland Cloud Services (Netlify)

Domain: stupendous-pie-54cb74.netlify.app
Purpose: API-key connection, usage metering, remote scheduling and the SmartAlt caption proxy.

Endpoints:
* https://stupendous-pie-54cb74.netlify.app/api/sio/connect
* https://stupendous-pie-54cb74.netlify.app/api/sio/disconnect
* https://stupendous-pie-54cb74.netlify.app/api/sio/check-reserve
* https://stupendous-pie-54cb74.netlify.app/api/sio/cron-sites
* https://stupendous-pie-54cb74.netlify.app/.netlify/functions/sio-smart-alt-new

Data sent: API key in request headers where required, plugin version and site identifier. Remote scheduling registration sends the heartbeat URL, per-site cron secret, pending-work counts and secret-rotation timestamp.

SmartAlt also sends the image URL, short-lived secure media URL or image data, plus relevant context. This can include site name, URL and language; attachment ID, title and filename; saved keywords; parent post details; and WooCommerce product details. Cloud requests include the requested response schema and captioning instructions.

When sent: key connection/disconnection actions; cloud usage checks and processing; scheduler registration on activation, periodic check-ins and queue-state changes. SmartAlt image requests occur when you generate suggestions, enable SmartAlt on upload, or start a background SmartAlt run. An authorised background run continues submitting eligible images after the browser closes until completed, paused, cancelled or stopped by an allowance/error condition.

Terms: https://www.webwonderland.co.uk/wwsio-terms/
Privacy: https://www.webwonderland.co.uk/wwsio-privacy-policy/

Replicate

Service: Replicate (replicate.com)
Purpose: AI caption generation behind Web Wonderland Cloud.

Data sent: image data or an image URL, captioning instructions and relevant context included in the captioning prompt. These are forwarded by Web Wonderland Cloud, not sent directly by the WordPress plugin. Your Cloud API key is not included in the captioning prompt.

When sent: SmartAlt suggestion generation, opted-in upload automation and authorised background caption runs.

Responses may include alt text, title, AI score, language, decorative-image status, warnings and keywords. The plugin stores these as attachment metadata for review and application.

Terms: https://replicate.com/terms
Privacy: https://replicate.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open SEO Image Optimiser > Setup Guide and choose your optimisation and delivery preferences.
  3. Optionally connect an API key under Cloud Services for remote conversions and SmartAlt.
  4. Use the Dashboard to optimise existing media, or Smart Alt & Titles (Cloud) for AI suggestions and background captioning.
  5. Start with a small image limit, review the results and use SmartAlt history to test undo before processing your whole library.
sections.faq:
Will optimisation replace my original image files?

The optimiser creates an original-file backup before optimisation. Use Restore Originals to recover those files. SmartAlt can separately change alt text and titles if you apply suggestions or authorise automatic application.

Will SmartAlt replace descriptions written by a person?

Missing-alt mode preserves existing descriptions. All-images auto-apply requires explicit permission to replace them. Undo skips changed fields that no longer match the saved AI result.

Can I use the plugin without AI?

Yes. SmartAlt is optional. Local image optimisation does not require an API key.
sections.changelog:
1.1.3

  • Adds resumable whole-library SmartAlt processing with missing-alt or all-image scope, image limits and progress counters.
  • Adds review-only or automatic application, explicit AI accuracy acknowledgement and separate permission to overwrite existing alt text.
  • Adds configurable AI-score thresholds and keeps decorative, missing-score and below-threshold results for review.
  • Adds pause/resume/cancel controls, quota-aware stops and recovery for interrupted background runs.
  • Adds durable before/after history for SmartAlt background, upload and manually applied changes.
  • Adds individual and background-run undo with protection for newer manual edits, partial-write recovery and interrupted-undo recovery.
  • Supports publicly accessible offloaded media in SmartAlt upload/background processing.
  • Hardens admin input/output and uploads, uses WordPress filesystem APIs and updates privacy guidance and admin assets.

1.1.2

  • Fixes Remote API processing mode persistence for connected API accounts, with validation and actionable save-error feedback.

Earlier detailed changes and upgrade notices are preserved in changelog.txt.
